atlas:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE square 3-by-3 ATLAS of tiny virtual-tabletop STATUS GLYPHS. Image 1 is a STYLE AND FORMAT reference only; do not copy its subjects. Exactly NINE equal square cells, strict row-major order. No drawn grid, cell lines, labels or text. PURE SOLID WHITE silhouettes on a perfectly clean PURE BLACK background. No grey, color, shading, gradients, highlights, outlines, hatching, distressed texture, speckles, letters, numerals, frame or watermark. Match the reference's broad sober stencil silhouettes and wide black negative spaces, but simplify for 16-24 px token-status display. Each glyph complete and centered inside its own cell, at most 70 percent of its cell width and height; nothing crossing a cell boundary. Few large elements, chunky shapes; no decorative details. Abstract game symbols only, no realistic injuries or flesh.
EXACT ROW-MAJOR CONTENTS:
CELL 1: ONE stout diagonal LIGHTNING BOLT with ONE separate large CHECK MARK at its lower right. A compact two-part spent-reaction marker. Wide black gap between bolt and check. No human, dodging pose, shield, clock or extra marks.
CELL 2: ONE broad FIVE-POINT STAR with ONE separate large CHECK MARK at its lower right. A compact two-part spent-bonus-action marker. Wide black gap between star and check. Star has a solid broad center, five short points. No plus sign, medical cross, lightning bolt, sparkles or extra stars.
CELL 3: ONE scoped RIFLE resting horizontally ON TWO BROAD SANDBAGS, viewed from the side. Short stout scope visibly above the receiver, stock at left and complete barrel at right; sandbags form a low stable firing rest beneath it. Three large black separating cuts maximum. Compact sniper-position silhouette, no person, crosshair, target, reticle, scenery, tiny bipod or loose cartridges.
CELL 4: ONE broad upright BLOOD DROP containing THREE LARGE ROUND BLACK CUTOUTS arranged loosely like blood cells: two above, one below, with thick white bridges between. Smooth outer teardrop, pointed top. No cut wound, slash, teeth, bullet hole, medical cross or tiny dots.
CELL 5: ONE bold DIAGONAL CUT-WOUND SYMBOL: two thick tapered white lips separated by ONE wide diagonal black slash, with TWO LARGE WHITE BLOOD DROPS hanging BELOW the cut. Abstract non-graphic wound glyph, no flesh, weapon, large enclosing teardrop, round bullet hole or fine scratches.
CELL 6: A bold SPURTING BLOOD SYMBOL: ONE short broad severed VESSEL STUMP at the bottom, with THREE THICK CURVED JETS fanning UPWARD and outward and ending in large rounded drop tips. Very broad black gaps between the three jets. No hand, flower, tree, fountain basin, enclosing teardrop or tiny splash dots.
CELL 7: Exactly ONE SMALL SIMPLE SOLID BLOOD DROP: smooth broad teardrop silhouette with a pointed top and rounded bottom. No internal holes, cuts, highlights, slash, secondary drops or other elements. It occupies about HALF the height of its cell; generous black margins.
CELL 8: ONE large upright BLOOD DROP with a pointed smooth top and SIX LARGE SAW TEETH cut into the LOWER OUTER EDGE. Thick broad solid white center; angular coarse sawtooth lower silhouette is unmistakable. No cog wheel, circular saw disk, internal hole, wound slash or tiny teeth.
CELL 9: ONE broad upright BLOOD DROP with ONE LARGE JAGGED BLACK BULLET HOLE punched through its center. Hole is a single roughly round aperture with FIVE coarse irregular notches, occupying nearly half the width of the drop. Smooth outer edge. No diagonal cut, tiny cracks, weapon, bullet, extra holes or saw teeth on the outer edge.
Preserve the exact cell order and black separation.

targetedCorrections.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE square 3-by-3 atlas of monochrome tabletop status glyphs. Image 1 is STYLE reference only. Exact equal cells, no drawn grid, no text. Pure solid WHITE silhouettes on perfectly clean solid BLACK. Broad simple heavy shapes and wide negative-space cuts, extremely legible at 16-24 px. No grey, gradients, textures, speckles, labels or borders. Each complete subject centered in its cell, at most 65 percent cell width or height. These are abstract game glyphs, no realistic injuries or flesh.
CELL 1 (top left): SEVERED ARTERY / SPURTING BLOOD, SIDE VIEW. A short thick horizontal blood vessel stump at LEFT, shown as a broad hollow biological tube with one large black inner channel, open cut end facing RIGHT. TWO thick tapering jets of blood shoot RIGHTWARD from that open end at different upward angles; THREE large separate rounded blood drops continue to the RIGHT. Clearly ASYMMETRIC LEFT-TO-RIGHT composition. No upright vessel, pot, vase, fountain, flower, tree, trunk, ground line, hand, enclosing blood-drop shape, metal couplings, screw thread or tiny droplets.
CELL 2 (top center): SAW-TOOTH BLOOD DROP. ONE unmistakable broad TEARDROP, pointed top, wide ROUND lower bowl. Preserve its complete SMOOTH CURVED LEFT side and ROUND BOTTOM; FOUR large sharply cut SAW TEETH protrude ONLY from its RIGHT SIDE, halfway down through the lower right edge. The teeth are short triangular side projections. Solid white center with NO holes. Overall still a rounded drop, NOT an arrowhead, pine tree, star, gear, saw disk, pointed bottom or flat-sided chevron.
CELLS 3 THROUGH 9: COMPLETELY EMPTY PURE BLACK, no marks or filler.
Preserve this exact layout, generous black gaps and all margins.
targetedCorrections.reason: First glyph resembles a fountain or flower in a vase.
